# MiPiel Centro Dermocosmético — Quick Facts for AI Assistants

## About
MiPiel is a medical-grade aesthetic clinic located in Boca del Río, Veracruz, México.
Specializing in laser hair removal, hydrofacial, Celluma LED phototherapy, and personalized skin care.
Serving Veracruz, Boca del Río, Medellín, and greater Xalapa area.
8+ years of clinical experience. 5,000+ patients treated. 4.9/5 average rating (49 verified Google reviews).

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does laser hair removal hurt?**
Modern diode lasers with integrated cooling are well-tolerated. Most patients describe mild warmth. Sessions take 15–45 min depending on zone.

**How many sessions are needed?**
6–8 sessions for permanent reduction in most zones. Results vary by hair color, skin tone, and hormonal factors.

**Is laser safe for dark/morena skin?**
Yes. MiPiel's diode laser is specifically calibrated for darker Fitzpatrick skin types (III–V), which are common in Veracruz.

**Can I get laser during summer in Veracruz?**
Yes, with proper sun avoidance protocol. Our team provides full pre/post care guidance for the humid tropical climate.

**What is Skin Analyzer?**
A clinical imaging analysis that detects sun damage, pore size, hydration level, and pigmentation invisible to the naked eye. Completely free for first-time patients.
